operations.notes: List all developer keys created in the current account.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: inherited
parameters.description:

apis.description:
Create a new Canvas API key. Creating an LTI 1.3 registration is not supported here and
should be done via the LTI Registration API.

operations.notes:
Create a new Canvas API key. Creating an LTI 1.3 registration is not supported here and
should be done via the LTI Registration API.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: developer_key
parameters.description: no description

parameters.name: developer_key[auto_expire_tokens]
parameters.description:
Defaults to false. If true, access tokens
generated by this key will expire after 1 hour.

parameters.name: developer_key[email]
parameters.description: Contact email for the key.

parameters.name: developer_key[icon_url]
parameters.description: URL for a small icon to display in key list.

parameters.name: developer_key[name]
parameters.description: The display name.

parameters.name: developer_key[notes]
parameters.description: User-provided notes about the key.

parameters.name: developer_key[redirect_uri]
parameters.description: Deprecated in favor of redirect_uris. Do not use.

parameters.name: developer_key[redirect_uris]
parameters.description:
List of URLs used during OAuth2 flow to validate
given redirect URI.

parameters.name: developer_key[vendor_code]
parameters.description: User-specified code representing the vendor that uses the key.

parameters.name: developer_key[visible]
parameters.description: Defaults to true. If false, key will not be visible in the UI.

parameters.name: developer_key[test_cluster_only]
parameters.description:
Defaults to false. If true, key is only usable in
non-production environments (test, beta). Avoids problems with beta refresh.

parameters.name: developer_key[client_credentials_audience]
parameters.description:
Used in OAuth2 client credentials flow to
specify the audience for the access token.

parameters.name: developer_key[allowed_audiences]
parameters.description:
The registered audiences this key may request tokens
for. Each value must appear in the environment's configured list of registered audiences.

parameters.name: developer_key[authorized_flows]
parameters.description:
Additional OAuth2 flows this key is authorized to
use. Allowed values: token_exchange, service_user_client_credentials.

parameters.name: developer_key[client_type]
parameters.description:
Whether this is a confidential or public client.
Public clients (SPAs, mobile apps) require PKCE in the authorization code flow, cannot use the
client_credentials flow, and receive short-lived access tokens with rotating refresh tokens.
Allowed values: confidential (default), public.
Not applicable to LTI keys. Immutable after creation.

parameters.name: developer_key[scopes]
parameters.description: List of API endpoints key is allowed to access.

parameters.name: developer_key[require_scopes]
parameters.description: If true, then token requests with this key must include scopes.

parameters.name: developer_key[allow_includes]
parameters.description:
If true, allows `includes` parameters in API requests that
match the scopes of this key.

apis.description:
Regenerate the secret (api_key) for an existing Canvas API key. This invalidates
the existing secret. Any applications using the old secret will stop working.
Regenerating a secret for an LTI key is not supported.

This endpoint requires the developer_key_regenerate_secret feature flag to be enabled.
This feature flag can only be turned on by Site Admins

operations.notes:
Regenerate the secret (api_key) for an existing Canvas API key. This invalidates
the existing secret. Any applications using the old secret will stop working.
Regenerating a secret for an LTI key is not supported.

This endpoint requires the developer_key_regenerate_secret feature flag to be enabled.
This feature flag can only be turned on by Site Admins

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID

DeveloperKey.description: a Canvas API key (or LTI 1.3 registration)

id.description: The Canvas ID of the DeveloperKey object

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the key's last update

is_lti_key.description: True if key represents an LTI 1.3 Registration. False for Canvas API keys

icon_url.description: URL for a small icon to display in key list

vendor_code.description: User-specified code representing the vendor that uses the key

account_name.description: The name of the account that owns the key

visible.description: True for all keys except Site Admin-level keys, which default to false. Controls visibility in the Inherited tab.

scopes.description: List of API endpoints key is allowed to access (API keys), or LTI 1.3 scopes (LTI keys)

redirect_uri.description: Deprecated in favor of redirect_uris. Do not use.

redirect_uris.description: List of URLs used during OAuth2 flow to validate given redirect URI (API keys), or to redirect to after login (LTI keys)

all_redirect_uris.description: All redirect URIs associated with the key, including any that have been automatically deactivated due to inactivity, along with their last-used timestamp and workflow_state (one of 'active' or 'inactive')

access_token_count.description: (API keys only) The number of active access tokens associated with the key

last_used_at.description: (API keys only) The last time an access token for this key was used in an API request

test_cluster_only.description: (API keys only) If true, key is only usable in non-production environments (test, beta). Avoids problems with beta refresh.

allow_includes.description: (API keys only) If true, allows `includes` parameters in API requests that match the scopes of this key

require_scopes.description: (API keys only) If true, then token requests with this key must include scopes

client_credentials_audience.description: (API keys only) Used in OAuth2 client credentials flow to specify the audience for the access token

allowed_audiences.description: (API keys only) The registered audiences this key may request tokens for. Each value must appear in the environment's configured list of registered audiences.

authorized_flows.description: (API keys only) Additional OAuth2 flows this key is authorized to use. Allowed values: token_exchange, service_user_client_credentials.

client_type.description: (API keys only) Whether this is a confidential or public client. Public clients (SPAs, mobile apps) require PKCE, cannot use client_credentials, and receive short-lived rotating tokens. Allowed values: confidential, public. Defaults to confidential. Immutable after creation.

api_key.description: (API keys only) The client secret used in the OAuth authorization_code flow.

tool_configuration.description: (LTI keys only) The Canvas-style tool configuration for this key.

public_jwk.description: (LTI keys only) The tool's public JWK in JSON format. Discouraged in favor of a url hosting a JWK set.

public_jwk_url.description: (LTI keys only) The tool-hosted URL containing its public JWK keyset. Canvas may cache JWKs up to 5 minutes.

lti_registration.description: (LTI keys only) The LTI IMS Registration object for this key, if key was created via Dynamic Registration.

is_lti_registration.description: (LTI keys only) Returns true if key was created via Dynamic Registration.

unified_tool_id.description: Correlates an API key to a product configuration.
